decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is used).
Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as No. 8 Greencroft Road.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern or southern walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - No part of the roof of the single-storey rear extension shall be used as or altered to 	form a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area.

Condition : 8 - Notwithstanding the details shown in the approved plans, the extension hereby permitted 	shall be finished in red brick at ground floor level to a height matching the main house and with render above, and the northeast corner of the proposed two-storey side extension and the northeast corner of the proposed part two-storey part storey rear extension 	shall each be constructed with a red brick quoin detail to match those on the existing front and side elevations.  This shall be permanently retained.

Condition : 9 - The garage or car parking accommodation shown on Unnumbered A3 drawing entitled 'Proposed Plans Aug 04 Rev A', received 10 August 2004 shall be provided before the dwelling to which it relates is occupied and thereafter it shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.
description: Erection of part single storey side and rear extensions and erection of two storey side and part two storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
